song.title: I Will Buy You A New Life

guitar.notes: No iconic signature instrument well documented for Art Alexakis.

tone.target: bright alt-rock crunch with slight fuzz edge
tone.profile: bright alt-rock crunch with slight fuzz edge
tone.summary: Gate 1 -> Green OD -> Fuzz -> UK 45 -> UK Vintage 4x12 -> Guitar EQ 2 -> Tremolo -> Digital Delay -> Room -> Volume
corrections: lean a bit fuzzier than OD

rig.name: Everclear - I Will Buy You A New Life - Valeton GP-180

blocks.purpose: Clean up hum and stray noise inherent in alt-rock recording.
Provide the initial crunchy boost and mid-forward attack required for alt-rock rhythm.
blocks.gap: The 'Green OD' is chosen over Blues/OD 9 to capture a slightly more aggressive, yet still defined, crunch tone.

alternatives.reason: A good alternative for general crunchy rhythm tones.

blocks.purpose: Add the required 'slight fuzz grit' without overwhelming the core crunch tone.
blocks.gap: The Fuzz model is used to provide texture rather than heavy distortion, fulfilling the 'fuzz edge' requirement.

alternatives.reason: If a slightly more controlled fuzz tone is desired.

blocks.purpose: Simulate the 'Marshall or boutique brit amp' sound, providing punchy alt-rock headroom.
blocks.gap: The UK 45 is ideal for bright, mid-focused rock tones, matching the genre and gear clues.

alternatives.reason: A slightly more aggressive alternative if the tone needs more bite.

blocks.purpose: Provide the required '4x12' cabinet simulation with a classic British rock voicing.
Enhance the mid-forward attack and defined low end while maintaining clarity.
blocks.gap: Using EQ 2 allows for more precise sculpting of the midrange punch required in alt-rock.

alternatives.reason: A simpler alternative if less complex tone shaping is needed.

blocks.purpose: Add subtle movement and interest to the rhythm parts without sounding like a 'big reverb' or chorus.
blocks.gap: Tremolo is chosen over Chorus because the verdict explicitly avoids Chorus, but still requires some modulation/vibe element.

alternatives.reason: If absolutely no modulation is desired.

blocks.purpose: Add subtle depth and space to the rhythm parts without being distracting.
blocks.gap: A moderate delay is used to add dimension while keeping the overall mix 'dry' as requested.

alternatives.reason: If a shorter, more percussive echo effect is preferred.

blocks.purpose: Provide a natural, subtle sense of space (dry mix) without the washiness of big reverb.
blocks.gap: Room is preferred over Plate/Spring to maintain a more grounded, alt-rock feel and avoid excessive ambience.

alternatives.reason: If a slightly brighter, metallic room sound is desired.

blocks.purpose: Final master level adjustment to ensure the mix is balanced and punchy.

improvements.summary: Improve cabinet realism and definition by swapping the current IR for a more aggressive, punchy 4x12 voicing.

proposals.reason: Enhance mid-range definition and punch for alt-rock crunch.
proposals.expectedGain: Increased clarity and bite in the rhythm tone.
